ocr.notes: Minor differences: image reads 'Ned Donelly' and 'give another sparring exhibition'; the 'THE FIGHT TO COME OFF.' subhead is omitted.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Allen returned from Cincinnati, where $500 a side had been posted as forfeit for a fight with Joe Goss, and that Ned Donelly's $125 suit against him was postponed.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Dispatch. St. Louis, Monday Evening, May 1, 1876'; the Post-Dispatch name dates from 1878-12.

facts.fact: Allen returned to St. Louis from Cincinnati, where he had gone to cover Joe Goss's $500 forfeit money
Allen and Joe Goss each put up $500 forfeit at Cincinnati for a fight, to be raised to $1,000 once the time and place were set
Ned Donelly sued Allen for $125 before Justice Walther, 406 Morgan Street, claiming it was due for sparring exhibitions at the Comique; the hearing was postponed
Allen said he would continue living in St. Louis and had never intended otherwise

notes: The Donelly suit matches the unnumbered (000) index entry 'pay dispute with Ned Donnelly'.
